company.name: ShopGo
company.shortDescription: ShopGo is an eCommerce solution for merchants in emerging markets.
company.description: ShopGo is a comprehensive e-Commerce platform that makes selling online accessible to everyone in the MENA. The advantage of starting a store with ShopGo is the overall understanding of the business along with the technical needs, advising on the most optimized payment and shipping options, which products to sell and the legislations in any MENA country, thus compressing - effectively and efficiently - the time needed for an online store to go live. Furthermore, ShopGo offers its clients the needed support to overcome the challenges of selling online, ranging between marketing support, analytics-for-growth solutions and market penetration consultancy. ShopGo is the enabler-of-choice for many prominent MENA retailers in their quest to conquer the MENA online retail markets.
